Answer: C
Reason: The images demonstrate Scimitar syndrome, characterized by a hypoplastic right lung causing mediastinal shift to the right. The scimitar vein (anomalous pulmonary venous return) is seen running parallel to the right heart border on the chest X-ray (Figure 6), and the abnormal systemic artery supplying the right lower lobe is indicated inferiorly in the coronal CT reconstruction (Figure 1).
